incident-bot: INCIDENT: billing.metering.flush_delay - window_id=2026-03-16T22:00Z, lag=~14%, affected_emitter=usage-aggregator-2, severity=page
kevin: getting the page. seeing alert in Grafana for emitter lag +1h.
tara: oncall here, jumping in. what's customer impact?
kevin: preliminary - some customers flagged with overage alerts in UI for that window. backend counts are lower than expected in ledger. looks like flush cadence stalled.
billing-service: logged: "flush-worker-2 crashed: OOM" at 22:07 UTC. kube restarted it, but backlog not flushed.
sophia: is there a retry/replay for the emitter? can we trigger a manual flush to S3->ingest?
kevin: yes, we have a manual runbook step: curl to /admin/flush?window=2026-03-16T22:00Z on emitter. trying now.
kevin: (runs) ```curl -XPOST https://billing-internal/admin/flush -d '{"window":"2026-03-16T22:00Z"}' --header 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**'``` got 200 queued.
incident-bot: ACTION: manual_flush queued by kevin, job-id=flush-1769994321-01
tara: ok i'll monitor token delta. running quick query:
tara: ```SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage_staging WHERE window='2026-03-16T22:00Z'; -- current: 1,304,112 expected ~1,520,000```
sophia: that's ~14% short. also see pending SQS backlog ~120k messages for emitter.
kevin: rerouting note: enabling fallback aggregator (agg-standby) to take pressure and replay missing msgs.
sophia: does this affect billing tallies? customers saw overage flags but ledger lower = mismatch that triggered frontend alerts.
billing-service: frontend overage flag flow: we raise "possible-overage" when projected tokens > threshold AND ledger confirms. Looks like frontend read from projection cache which used cached pre-crash projections. flagging customers incorrectly.
tara: mitigation plan: 1) finish manual flush + replay 2) clear projection cache to avoid stale overage flags 3) verify tallies and retract false alerts 4) follow-up postmortem + credits if customers hit real overage incorrectly
kevin: manual flush completed, job-id flush-1769994321-01 marked done at 1769994460.
incident-bot: EVENT: replay-job started by billing-service, replay-id=replay-1769994321-01
sophia: replays applied ~1,480,000 tokens, delta now +176k vs staging before. verifying ledger -> now matches expected within 1.2%.
tara: clearing projection cache now -> ```curl -XPOST https://cache-internal/clear?key=proj*``` done.
billing-service: removing temporary overage flags in UI. sending broadcast to support: "false overage flags cleared for impacted windows; customers should see corrected usage in 10-15m"
kevin: confirm telemetry: dashboards now show window token counts normalized. will keep watch for 1 hour.
sophia: root cause: flush-worker OOM after a large spike; autoscaler didn't spin up because pod OOM killed primary before HPA ramp. Add to backfill: increase flush-worker mem and add sidecar to stream to S3 with backpressure.
tara: oncall handoff in 45m to ops-shift. leaving notes in incident doc. good work.
kevin: will open incident ticket and label billing/metering/flush-delay.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> mitigation applied. severity downgraded to info. followup: postmortem assigned to sophia, runbook update assigned to kevin.
sophia: will draft postmortem and propose runbook patch with safer flush behavior and cache invalidation step.
kevin: recording credits checklist for customers with erroneous overage flags.
tara: thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-runbot: note added to incident log: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1769994321
